title: Document OCR and RAG on Amazon Bedrock
excerpt: Textract OCR, chunking, embeddings and pgvector retrieval on Amazon Bedrock, returning structured answers an app can use.

metrics.label: Ingest and answer, each testable on its own
OCR, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, structured output

content:
01 · Discover

Scanned documents in, structured answers out

The goal was an app that could ask questions of PDFs and scans and get back fields it can use directly, not a paragraph of prose to parse.

02 · Architect

Two paths through one store

Ingest: Amazon Textract reads the pages, the text is cleaned and split into chunks, Amazon Bedrock embeds each chunk, and the vectors land in pgvector on Postgres. Answer: the question is embedded with the same model, the closest passages are retrieved, and a model on Bedrock answers in JSON fields.

03 · Build

Stage by stage

The pipeline was built stage by stage: OCR first, then chunking and embeddings, then retrieval and structured output, each one testable on its own.
